description: Daily vital reading: one day's aggregated resting heart rate inside a wellness history container (health v2.5)
notes: Uses the health:date / health:value / health:unit spelling emitted by the Swift SDK's HealthProfileSerializer. health:DailyVitalReadingShape accepts a timestamp in either that spelling or the reference pod's cascade:date, because both emitters are live; this fixture covers the first and the reference pod covers the second.
